the Control key on a computer keyboard

clue.text: Primarily 'correspondence': arcane Biblical beliefs; Abrahamic literature absorbed?

definitions.text: Primarily 'correspondence': arcane Biblical beliefs; Abrahamic literature absorbed?

indicators.note: primarily means firstly, so only the opening letter of each following word counts

explanation.definitionFit: Cabbala is the Jewish mystical tradition of interpreting scripture through hidden symbolism, an esoteric body of religious thought.

clue.text: Whereby unpleasant burden is exclusing reek, primarily?

definitions.text: Whereby unpleasant burden is exclusing reek, primarily?

indicators.note: primarily means at first, so only the opening letter of the word before it is wanted
excluding (as misspelt in the clue) tells us to leave a letter out of the word in front
something unpleasant is not nice or orderly, hinting the letters should be disturbed

blocks.note: taken as written
the first letter of reek

explanation.surface: A question about how a nasty load stops smelling.

explanation.definitionFit: A U-bend is the curved pipe under a sink or toilet whose trapped water blocks foul odours from drains.

clue.text: So Dad's starter comes on a salad? Something bad will inevitably occur

the first letter of Dad; the 's simply attaches the starter to him
slaw, short for coleslaw, is a cabbage salad

explanation.walkthrough: SOD'S LAW is a British name for the idea that whatever can go wrong will.
explanation.definitionFit: Sod's law is the British equivalent of Murphy's law: the principle that if anything can go wrong, it will.

explanation.definitionFit: Someone's handiwork is what they have done, as in 'this mess is your doing'.

the Roman numeral for one, which is removed
